# Fazeel Khan — Portfolio

Fazeel Khan is a full-stack developer and Computer Science student based in Multan, Punjab, Pakistan. He builds responsive, practical web applications using React, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, Firebase, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with a strong UI/UX sensibility from a graphic-design background.

He is available for remote internships, junior full-stack roles, freelance projects, and collaborations.

## Featured projects

### Golden Art Frames
A full-stack MERN e-commerce platform for custom photo products (prints, frames, canvas, collages, wedding products). Includes in-browser product editor, Stripe checkout, JWT auth, dynamic pricing, and an admin dashboard for orders, products, blog, and analytics.
Tech: MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, Stripe, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, JWT.

### Imagine AI Fashion Platform — Collaborative Project
A collaborative AI fashion / image-generation platform Fazeel contributed to (frontend and backend features). The platform handles AI-generated fashion visuals, prompt-driven workflows, and image generation interfaces. Fazeel is not the sole owner.
Repos: github.com/NVGEN/imagine-frontend · github.com/NVGEN/imagine-backend

### POS Desktop
A desktop point-of-sale and inventory management project by Fazeel Khan, focused on business software workflows, product management, stock tracking, and sales operations.
Repo: github.com/fazeelk2004/POS-Desktop

### Pak Origin Export
A business/export website project by Fazeel Khan, focused on responsive frontend development, commercial presentation, product sections, and contact conversion.
Repo: github.com/fazeelk2004/pakoriginexport

### NobleAcres
A real estate web application with React, Redux Toolkit, Firebase, and JWT authentication — listing creation, protected routes, and landlord/tenant interaction.

### ThinkBoard
A MERN note-taking application with full CRUD, REST API, toast notifications, and rate limiting.

## Other projects
- NeuraLearn (School Dashboard UI) — TypeScript / React / Next.js dashboard interface.
- Chatbot AI — Python conversational chatbot project.
- LMS Quiz AI Generated — JavaScript LMS/quiz app with AI-generated content concept.
